findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "qualitative_quote_analysis" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: qualitative_get_capabilities, qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis · Private data: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_account, qualitative_list_runs, qualitative_get_run, qualitative_list_deliverables, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis · Public sink: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_start_analysis · Destructive: qualitative_get_run, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: qualitative_get_capabilities, qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis · Private data: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_get_account, qualitative_list_runs, qualitative_get_run, qualitative_list_deliverables, qualitative_get_deliverable, qualitative_start_analysis, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis · Public sink: qualitative_quote_analysis, qualitative_start_analysis · Destructive: qualitative_get_run, qualitative_retry_analysis, qualitative_cancel_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
